http/digest#

Digest authentication (RFC 7616) with SHA-256 and SHA-512-256, qop=auth.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let client = DigestExchanging(
    origin: HttpClient(),
    scope: ParsedUrl("https://example.com/private/").parts(),
    credentials: DigestCredentials(username: "ann", password: secret),
    random: SecureRandom(),
);
await client.response(Request(url: "https://example.com/private/report"));

Description#

Digest authentication (RFC 7616) with SHA-256 and SHA-512-256, qop=auth.

A 401 with a Digest challenge inside the scope is answered once, and a stale nonce once more. There is no MD5, no preemptive nonce cache and no body hashing. The server's Authentication-Info proof can be checked with DigestServerProof.

object DigestChallenge#

object DigestChallenge

Explicit SHA-256/SHA-512-256 profile and session variants, qop=auth. UTF-8 challenges normalize username/password to NFC. Without charset, credentials remain ASCII. No MD5 fallback or inferred body hashing.

object DigestExchanging#

object DigestExchanging does Exchanging

No preemptive nonce cache or domain expansion. A direct scoped 401 can authorize one replay; one further stale=true/new-nonce refresh is bounded.
